specification_compliance: I2 (scroll anchor across entering and leaving) is still served. toggleFocusMode remembers the anchor synchronously before it toggles the store (useFocusMode.ts:102-105). AppShell.tsx:336-344 restores the anchor when focusLayout changes and drops it when the toggle leaves the layout unchanged (below 768px).
potential_unspecified_behavior: Pressing T below 768px now captures an anchor (with a DOM probe) and drops it in the same commit's layout effect. Before, no anchor was taken. Nothing visible should change, because capture only reads layout.
regression_risks: AppShell.tsx:338 compares a ref with focusLayout. If focusLayout changes without a toggle (a resize across 768px with the state on, or leaving the file page URL), restoreReadingAnchor runs with pending normally null. That is a no-op unless an anchor was left pending, and forgetReadingAnchor on the earlier same-layout commit should prevent that.
